title: Lavender Cabinet Pull, 3 Inch Solid Brass Cabinet Mount Handle, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
description: Cabinet pull with 3 inch size, solid brass construction, and cabinet-mount installation for updating kitchen or bathroom cabinets and drawers in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. Traditional style with a refined, timeless look; contemporary design with traditional design elements. Overall dimensions: 3.9 in L x 1.6 in H x 0.9 in W with 1 in projection. Includes cabinet pull and all installation hardware; no assembly required. Supports up to 2 lb. Designed to coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures while fitting cabinetry throughout the home. Available in multiple lifetime designer finishes and covered by a limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
